blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Charoen Pokphand Foods Philippines Corp. (CPFPC) is spending up to P300 million to expand a poultry farm in Tarlac. The local unit of Thai conglomerate Charoen Pokphand Foods Public Co. Ltd. is amending its environmental compliance certificate (ECC) for a breeder poultry farm in the town of Pura to reflect CPFPC as the new farm operator and to add project components. READ: Thai firm wants to build P500-M plant in Bataan Furhemore, CPFPC explained that a broiler breeder farm raises parent-stock hens and roosters to produce fertile hatching eggs.
